title: Truncated simplex coend embeds as the skeleton
statement:
Use simplicial sets of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Let $S:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sets}$ be any small simplicial set and $k\geq0$. Write $\Delta^a_q=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([q],[a])$. Form the simplicial set
$$R_k(S)=\operatorname{coeq}\left(\coprod_{\alpha:[a]\to[b],\ a,b\leq k}S_b\times\Delta^a\rightrightarrows\coprod_{a\leq k}S_a\times\Delta^a\right),$$
where the arrows are induced by $S(\alpha)$ and postcomposition with $\alpha$ on standard simplices. Thus a degree-$q$ representative is $[x,\beta]$, with $x\in S_a$, $a\leq k$, and $\beta:[q]\to[a]$. The map $j_k:R_k(S)\to S$, $[x,\beta]\mapsto S(\beta)x$, is degreewise injective. Its image consists exactly of those simplices whose unique nondegenerate ancestor has dimension at most $k$; equivalently it is the simplicial subset generated by all simplices of dimension at most $k$. The canonical map from $R_k(S)$ to the unrestricted coend $\int^{[a]}S_a\times\Delta^a\cong S$ is $j_k$. These maps and identifications are natural in $S$ and commute with the truncation maps $R_k(S)\to R_{k+1}(S)$.
